title: The number of branches at a point is controlled by the normalisation in a neighbourhood
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma relates the number of local branches of a scheme at a point to the number of points of the normalisation lying over it, in a neighbourhood of the point. The proof analyses the normalisation morphism locally, counts the points of the fibre over the given point, and shows that this count is stable in a neighbourhood, using that the normalisation is finite over a locally Noetherian base. The stability argument for the count is what the lemma turns on. Retained author proof at lines 10354-10402.
